gloss: terms of service; terms of use

definitions.gloss: terms of service; terms of use; usage agreement
definitions.explanation: A legal agreement setting out the rules and conditions for using a service, website, or application. Users typically must agree to these terms before registering or using the service.

examples.japanese: ご{利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}をよくお{読|よ}みください。
examples.english: Please read the Terms of Service carefully.

examples.japanese: アカウントを{作成|さくせい}する{際|さい}は、{利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}に{同意|どうい}する{必要|ひつよう}があります。
examples.english: When creating an account, you must agree to the Terms of Service.

examples.japanese: {利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}に{違反|いはん}した{場合|ばあい}、アカウントが{停止|ていし}されることがあります。
examples.english: If you violate the Terms of Service, your account may be suspended.

notes:
Combines {利用|りよう} (use, utilization) and {規約|きやく} (rules, regulations). Ubiquitous in online services and apps.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}に{同意|どうい}する: to agree to the terms of service
- {利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}に{違反|いはん}する: to violate the terms of service
- {利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the terms of service

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {利用|りよう}{条件|じょうけん}: terms of use — similar; slightly more general
- プライバシーポリシー: privacy policy — related but covers data handling
